purpose: Classified documentation audit, not a second implementation plan or compiler qualification.

review_methods.current-content: Reviewed current instructions, authority, entry commands, coverage/performance limits and local navigation against the canonical contract.
review_methods.scope-and-targeted-content: Reviewed authority, source/date boundaries, entry links, conflict-pattern matches and changed passages; preserved other source-bound result bodies.
review_methods.scope-and-links: Reviewed historical-plan declaration and navigation; no plan or historical result reinterpretation.
review_methods.scope-and-conflict-scan: Reviewed title/opening authority, source/date scope, local links and repository-wide forbidden-direction pattern matches; not a new audit of every historical assertion.
review_methods.inventory-only: Classified by path boundary and exact Git blob/current hash; preserved bytes. Did not semantically reread donor manuals or immutable evidence as new instructions.
review_methods.audit-record-content: Reviewed new audit-record findings, source and execution scope, links and limits; preserved its original evidence bytes. This is not a new compiler run.

rules: While PR33 is unmerged, governing docs on next do not imply corrected compiler source; resolve the live PR head. After merge verify the current integration source contains the correction, rather than resuming a closed PR.
Only Lustr Lust implementation owns pinned Lust-covered work. A bridge or integration gap never assigns complementary ownership.
Retired whole-compiler, coordinator, retry, engine-selector and benchmark-acquisition recipes are historical, never current product routes.
Independent stock compilers remain qualification/bootstrap references only, with explicit source and result scope.
Current speed claims use fixed workload frequencies and paired total elapsed costs; old statistics and failed results remain historical.
A no_std serializer or generated-program Unix API repair does not establish a no_std or socket-independent retained compiler.
Donor selection follows upstream/bluefe-core.pin, not a moving blueFe/Rust branch.
No compiler, benchmark, hosted CI, product release or semantic completeness is qualified by this documentation inventory.
limits: All 396 baseline Markdown files are inventoried, not all historical assertions freshly re-proved.
Immutable evidence and pristine donor content are intentionally untouched.
The baseline list remains bound to 396 files. post_baseline_documents separately classifies additions observed in the integration input. This JSON is excluded from its own content-hash inventory.
Future changes require updating reviewed hashes and dispositions; this snapshot is not an automated proof that later guidance is correct.

current_observation.scope: The 396 baseline rows use reviewed documentation content, including this documentation follow-through; newly added audit records are listed separately. Compiler/CI source comes from the integration input. This is not compiler qualification.
